newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nintendo shares gain ground on strong sales.
newsitem.headline: Nintendo shares gain ground on strong sales.

text.p: Shares in Nintendo Co Ltd continued to gain ground on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on Friday morning because of robust sales of its game software, dealers said.
The shares stood at 9,910 yen at 0056 GMT, up 210 yen from the previous day's closing.

A dealer at a major Japanese brokerage said that in addition to robust sales of the company's game software, investors are attracted to the issue as it was included in the new stock options on individual issues.
Trading in the new stock options will start on July 18.
